other_conditions: Applicant must have saved the life of a victim of a fatal motor vehicle accident by providing immediate assistance and transporting the victim to a hospital within the Golden Hour.
Applicant must be willing to disclose their details; those who do not disclose details are not eligible for the award.
benefits_summary: Award of ₹5,000 per Good Samaritan per incident, with additional national-level awards of ₹1,00,000 for the top ten performers each year.
documents_required: Copy of the Acknowledgement (Annexure A) issued by the police or hospital on official letterhead.
